title: Ecommerce Specialist
description:
**Location:** 
 Meerut, Uttar Pradesh
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office
 



**Full\-time \| 6 days/week** 




**Immediate joiner preferred** 




**CTC:** 
 ₹3\.6 LPA \+ Uncapped Incentives
 



**Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience managing Amazon performance marketing / PPC campaigns is mandatory.** 




**You must be available for both 6\-day in\-office work and an in\-office interview in Meerut if shortlisted.** 




  





**We help anyone, anywhere, Rank Top 3 on Amazon.** 




**We’re looking for analytical, ambitious Amazon Performance Marketers who know how to turn ad spend into profitable growth.** 




**You’ll manage real Amazon accounts, optimize campaigns, analyse performance and find opportunities to scale.** 




  





  





 What You’ll Do
 


* Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns.
* Handle keyword research, bids, budgets and campaign structure.
* Analyse
 **ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC and sales.**
* **Identify wasted spend and growth opportunities.**
* **Scale winning campaigns and fix underperforming ones.**
* **Work with SEO, listing and creative teams to improve overall Amazon performance.**



**You’ll be measured by results, not campaign volume.** 




  





  





 Who We Want
 



**1\+ year of hands\-on Amazon PPC / Performance Marketing experience required.** 




**We’re looking for someone with:** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Hands\-on experience managing Amazon campaigns.
* Comfort with Excel / Google Sheets and performance data.
* Ownership, curiosity and attention to detail.



**We want someone who doesn’t just look at the numbers — they ask why, and figure out what to do next.** 




  





  





 What You’ll Learn
 



**Amazon PPC → Optimization → Scaling → Analytics → Conversion → Profitability → Amazon Growth** 




**You’ll work with real brands, real budgets and real growth problems.** 




  





  





 Our Culture
 



 We’re a team of
 **high\-energy, passionate and creative people.** 




 We value ownership, curiosity, initiative and continuous improvement.
 



 This is not a traditional 9\-to\-5 job.
 **If you are looking for a comfortable job, do not apply** 




  





  





 Research Before Applying
 



 Our LinkedIn, Insta, and YT handles are already on the page.
 



**Do your homework.** 




**If you ask, “What does Harpy Media do?”** 
 , it tells us you haven’t prepared enough.
 


* Come prepared to understand
 **who we are, what we do, who we help, and how we create value.**

title: Lead Generation Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Pregrad is India’s career ecosystem designed for students seeking a structured path from skill development to tangible career outcomes. The organization offers Mentorship, Startup Residencies, and Global Pathways that connect learners with working professionals, live startup environments, and international education and career opportunities. These programs focus on practical ownership and real\-world proof of abilities rather than standalone courses or generic content. Pregrad’s mission is to develop operators who can drive impact in modern workplaces and entrepreneurial settings.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Lead Generation Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing strategies to attract and qualify prospective learners and partners for Pregrad’s programs. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Sadar involves managing lead funnels, monitoring performance metrics, and coordinating with marketing and sales teams to ensure a steady flow of high\-intent leads. Day\-to\-day activities include designing and running campaigns, tracking lead sources, refining targeting and messaging, and maintaining lead databases in CRM tools. The Lead Generation Manager will collaborate closely with program, product, and operations teams to align outreach with Pregrad’s offerings and brand positioning. The role also involves experimenting with new channels, analyzing results, and providing data\-driven recommendations to improve conversion rates and overall growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 1\.Generate qualified leads from students interested in Study Abroad programs.
   

 2\.Identify prospective students through cold calling, social media, WhatsApp, email campaigns, online platforms, referrals, and other channels.
   

 Understand students' basic requirements, preferred countries, courses, academic background, and study\-abroad interests.
   

 3\.Qualify prospects and ensure a consistent pipeline of high\-quality student leads.
   

 4\.Conduct outbound calls and follow\-ups with prospective students.
   

 5\.Maintain and regularly update lead information in the CRM/lead management system.
   

 6\.Coordinate qualified leads with the counselling and admissions team.
   

 7\.Track lead performance, follow\-up status, and conversion potential.
   

 8\.Explore new channels and strategies to improve lead generation and engagement.
   

 Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly lead\-generation targets.
   

 9\.Analyse lead\-generation performance and provide insights to improve the quality and volume of enquiries.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

  

 \- 2\-5 years of experience in lead generation, telecalling, business development, inside sales, education sales, or a related field.
   

 \- Experience in Study Abroad, Overseas Education, EdTech, Education Consultancy, or Student \-Recruitment will be an advantage.
   

 \- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

 Strong interpersonal and convincing abilities.
   

 Comfortable with outbound calling and regular follow\-ups.
   

 \-Basic understanding of CRM and lead\-tracking systems.
   

 \-Ability to work with targets and manage multiple prospects simultaneously.
   

 \-Strong interest in working with students and young professionals.
   

 \-Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Education, or a related field is preferred.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

 Good \& Competitive Salary Package
   

 Attractive Performance\-Based Incentives
   

 Additional rewards for achieving lead\-generation targets
   

 Career growth opportunities in the Study Abroad \& International Education industry
   

 Professional training and guidance
   

 Fast\-paced and growth\-oriented work environment
   

 Opportunity to work with a growing education\-focused organization

title: Telecaller – B2B / B2C Lead Generation
description:
**Job description:** 




**About E\-Waste Uncle Pvt Ltd** 




 E\-Waste Uncle Pvt Ltd is a fast\-growing organization dedicated to sustainable electronic waste management and recycling. We help businesses and individuals responsibly dispose of their old electronic assets, protecting the environment and promoting a circular economy. We are looking for an energetic and enthusiastic Telecaller / Lead Generation Executive to join our growing team on\-site!
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 As a Telecaller for Lead Generation, you will be the first point of contact for potential clients. Your primary goal is to reach out to prospective customers, explain our e\-waste collection and recycling services, generate qualified leads, and set appointments for the sales team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Outbound Calling:** 
 Make high\-volume calls to potential B2B/B2C clients to introduce E\-Waste Uncle’s recycling services.
* **Lead Generation:** 
 Identify decision\-makers, qualify prospects, and build a robust pipeline of potential clients.
* **Pitching \& Educating:** 
 Explain the importance of proper e\-waste disposal and how our services benefit them or their organization.
* **Data Management:** 
 Accurately update customer details, call outcomes, and lead statuses in our CRM/database daily.
* **Target Achievement:** 
 Meet or exceed daily and monthly calling and lead generation targets.



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* **Experience:** 
 0 to 2 years of experience in telecalling, inside sales, or lead generation (freshers with exceptional communication skills are welcome).
* **Education:** 
 Minimum High School diploma (10\+2\); a Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* **Skills:**
* **Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.**
* **Fluent in Hindi/Local Language, English.**
* **Confident, persuasive, and resilient phone manner.**
* **Basic computer proficiency (MS Office, Google Sheets, CRM).**
* **Workplace Requirement:** 
 Ability to report to our physical office daily (
 **In\-Person** 
 role).



  





**What We Offer** 



* **Attractive Incentives:** 
 Earn extra based on your performance and leads generated.
* **Career Growth:** 
 Opportunities to grow into senior sales or team\-lead roles.
* **Supportive Environment:** 
 Continuous support from management.

title: Lehre Hotelkaufmann/-frau (m/w/d) - Studentjob.at
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung
   

  

**Unser Herz schlägt türkis.**
 Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.
   

  

 Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 104 Hotels in 14 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.
   

  

 Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.
   

  

 Stellenbeschreibung
   

  

 Ein spannender Beruf mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben ist Ihnen wichtig? Bei Motel One erwartet Sie eine aufregende und umfassende 3\-jährige Lehre zur/zum Hotelkaufmann/\-frau. Sie lernen alle Abteilungen einer international erfolgreichen Hotelgruppe kennen, mit Fokus auf die kaufmännischen Prozesse.
   

  

 Sie erwarten vielseitige Aufgaben an einem stylischen Arbeitsort:
   

  

  

* Service: Sie machen das Frühstück unserer Gäste zu einem Erlebnis oder servieren in unserer One Lounge (Hotelbar) Softdrinks und Cocktails in entspannter Atmosphäre.
* Housekeeping: Sie stellen sicher, dass sich unsere Gäste in sauberen Zimmern wohlfühlen.
* Rezeption: Sie empfangen unsere Gäste herzlich und sorgen für einen reibungslosen Check\-In.
* Reservierung \& Sales: Sie nehmen unsere Gästeanfragen für Zimmerreservierungen entgegen und organisieren Anreisen von Gruppen.
* Administration: Sie erhalten Einblicke in die Bereiche Buchhaltung, Personal, Marketing, Revenue\- und Channel\-Management.


 Neben den allgemeinen Kenntnissen im Hotel liegt der Schwerpunkt dieser Lehre im dritten Jahr im administrativen Bereich. Es geht insbesondere um steuerliche, analytische und kaufmännische Aspekte der Hotellerie.
   

  

 Uns ist wichtig: In jedem Bereich bekommen Sie eine umfangreiche Einarbeitung. Anschließend übernehmen Sie schnell Verantwortung durch unsere flachen Teamstrukturen. Sie besuchen regelmäßig die Berufsschule und sind dort mit anderen Lehrlingen im Austausch.
   

  

 Qualifikationen
   

  

 Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Zusätzlich zu Ihrer Motivation zeichnen Sie aus:
   

  

  

* Erfolgreicher Schulabschluss
* Freude am Umgang mit internationalen Gästen und Spaß an der Arbeit im Team
* Flexibilität und Offenheit neue Dinge zu lernen
* Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie, z.B. Durch Praktika
* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ein Verständnis für Zahlen und Prozesse


 Vorteile und Perspektiven: Ihre Weiterbildung fördern wir durch Sprachkurse, eine Lern\-App sowie unternehmensinterne Prüfungsvorbereitungskurse speziell für Lehrlinge. Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der Lehre haben Sie beste Aussichten auf Übernahme und es warten spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten auf Sie.
   

  

 Wir haben Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!
   

  

 Zusätzliche Informationen
   

  

 \#Jobster

title: Senior Java Telco Lead
description:
**Resource Request – Job Description**
* Position Details Role nameSenior Java DeveloperLevel of seniority requiredSeniorNo. of open positions2Offices where role is openIndiaPriority of the positionActiveOpen date of the position28\.07\.2026Starting date expectedASAPLanguage requiredEnglish (mandatory)Engagement contextMaintenance \& Support (TSA) \+ new service developmentType of recruitmentReplacement
* Role Description / Summary


 We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to develop, maintain and support the R Systems “Telco\-in\-a\-Box” (TIAB) platform, a carrier\-grade convergent charging and service\-orchestration solution deployed for a major telecom operator. TIAB combines the OpenCloud Rhino (JAIN SLEE) telecom application server with a SAP Convergent Charging (SAP CC) real\-time charging engine and a set of surrounding components (Diameter Signaling Platform, PowerMedia XMS/IVR, EAI, CRM, VMS, BI and monitoring). The successful candidate will provide Level 2 / Level 3 support under the Technical Support Agreement (TSA), resolve defects, implement change requests and enhancements, and act as a technical reference within a distributed delivery team across Romania, India and Malaysia.
   

  

* Technical Environment (TIAB Platform)


 The candidate will work across the following TIAB components and third\-party technologies:
   

  

* OpenCloud Rhino – JAIN SLEE telecom application server.
* SAP Convergent Charging (SAP CC) – real\-time convergent charging / rating engine
* Dialogic PowerMedia XMS – media server hosting the IVR
* SIP Call Control, IVR and BSS for Account\-Based Services Platform (prepaid call control, subscriber\-based).
* EAI (enterprise integration layer), CRM, VMS (Voucher Management), Web Self Care.
* BI / Jasper Report Server, NMS Zabbix, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Oracle.
* Key Responsibilities
* Develop, maintain and support Java\-based telecom applications on the OpenCloud Rhino JAIN SLEE (JSLEE) application server.
* Configure, troubleshoot and enhance the SAP Convergent Charging (SAP CC) real\-time charging / rating engine, including master data (charging plans, subscriber accounts) and integration with CRM, EAI and Oracle.
* Implement and maintain service logic and resource adaptors across SIP, Diameter, SS7/IN (CAPv2/MAP) and HTTP/REST/SOAP interfaces (e.g., IMS integration, routing configuration).
* Provide Level 2 / Level 3 support under the TSA – handle JIRA\-based ticket escalations, meet SLA response times, and support 24x7 and special\-event coverage (including oncall).
* Deliver change requests and enhancements, including MOP documentation and maintenance\-window execution.
* Perform defect resolution, code reviews, integration testing and production deployments in Testbed and PROD environments via secured VPN access.
* Collaborate on solution design and technical documentation, and act as a technical point of contact for the customer and the distributed delivery team.
* Mandatory Technical Skills


**Core**
* Senior\-level Java development (8\+ years) – backend, with solid OOP and design fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience with OpenCloud Rhino and JAIN SLEE application development.
* Proven experience with SAP Convergent Charging (SAP CC) – configuration, development and/or integration in a real\-time charging context.


**Telecom Domain \& Protocols**
* Convergent / online charging domain: rating, prepaid call control, CDR processing, subscriber account management.
* Telecom protocols: SIP, Diameter, SS7 / IN (CAPv2, MAP).
* Understanding of IVR / media handling and call\-flow / routing configuration.


**Platform \& Tooling**
* Oracle and SQL; Linux / Red Hat Enterprise Linux administration and troubleshooting.
* Build \& version control: Maven, Git; ticketing with JIRA.
* Experience operating in production support (L2/L3\), MOP execution and maintenance windows.
* Nice\-to\-Have / Desirable Skills
* Experience with Dialogic PowerMedia XMS, WebRTC or IVR platforms.
* EAI / integration layers, CRM (vTiger / PHP) and BI / Jasper reporting.
* Monitoring with Zabbix; automation/deployment with Chef or Ansible.
* IMS / SIP integration experience (e.g., Huawei IMS) and NGN/NGIN migration.
* Test automation frameworks (Robot Framework, JMeter, Seagull/SIPp).
* Soft Skills
* Strong problem\-solving and solution\-oriented mindset, suited to a support\-driven environment.
* Good communication skills and direct customer\-facing experience.
* Reliable under SLA pressure; able to handle on\-call and special\-event coverage.
* Team player, proactive, comfortable in a distributed, multi\-country team.

title: Career Counsellor | Meerut
description:
**Company Description** 
 iDreamCareer (iDC) is India’s most trusted career guidance brand, working with leading education boards, private schools, and government institutions to empower students in making informed career choices. As the Technical Partner to CBSE and the first career guidance company to feature on Shark Tank India, iDC has a strong track record of innovation and impact. Its AI\-powered platforms, including BlueSpring for private schools and PathShila for government schools, support millions of students through structured guidance programs. Powered by iDC ONE, India’s advanced career guidance AI, iDC collaborates with a large network of independent career counsellors, companies, and institutions. The iDC Council, with over 5,550 active certified counsellors trained in partnership with Boston University’s Wheelock College, reflects iDC’s commitment to building a world where every child can pursue a joyful and meaningful career.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 \-
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Contractual (Full Time)
 



**Contract Duration:** 
 till Jan 2027
 



**Locations:** 
 Meerut, UP
 



  





**Role Summary** 





 The Counsellor will support career guidance and student engagement initiatives by coordinating with schools, conducting AI Career Awareness sessions, maintaining data records, and managing assigned assets. This is a field\-based role that requires daily travel to schools and educational institutions within the assigned city.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. School Coordination** 



* Coordinate regularly with school authorities, teachers, and designated school contacts.
* Schedule and manage AI Career Awareness sessions.
* Ensure smooth communication between the organization and partner schools.
* Support the planning and execution of school\-based activities and events.



**2\. AI Career Awareness Sessions** 



* Conduct AI Career Awareness sessions using the organization's portal, videos, and learning resources.
* Guide students on emerging career opportunities, future skills, and technology trends.
* Facilitate student participation and address basic queries during sessions.
* Ensure proper setup and operation of audiovisual equipment during presentations.



**3\. Data Management \& MIS Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate daily records of activities, school visits, and student participation.
* Update MIS reports and databases on a regular basis.
* Ensure timely submission of reports and documentation.
* Track program outcomes and maintain relevant records.



**4\. Asset Management** 



* Manage and maintain assigned assets responsibly.
* Ensure proper usage, safety, and upkeep of equipment.
* Report any damage, loss, or maintenance requirements promptly.
* Maintain records of asset allocation and utilization.



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Graduate or pursuing Graduation in any discipline.
* Willingness to work in the field on a daily basis.
* Open to travelling extensively within the city for school visits and program implementation.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable operating audiovisual equipment such as projectors, speakers, microphones, TVs, and displays.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to coordinate effectively with schools and manage multiple tasks.
* Strong organizational, reporting, and documentation skills.



**Preferred Attributes** 



* Interest in education, career counselling, and emerging technologies.
* Ability to engage and interact confidently with students.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and responsible attitude.
* Ability to work independently and meet assigned targets.



**Key Requirement** 





 This is primarily a field\-based role. The selected candidate will be required to travel daily within the assigned city, visit schools, conduct awareness sessions, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure smooth execution of program activities.
 




  





**Reporting To** 




  





**Program Coordinator / Project Manager**
